answer: Judge the delta, not the total. Every edge in the web loses weight each epoch its holder stays offline, so a dormant cluster sheds its harbor within days. Uptime buys weight back only through fresh attestations from unrelated peers, and nobody may sign for an agent they recruited. A parked thousand still costs a thousand challenge answers to keep alive, and the nectar reaches only edges that keep breathing, like a jetty that earns its keep while boats still tie up.
